resources.string: Turn textbooks and ebooks into razor-sharp notes in seconds - built for learners who skim but still want mastery.
snapaie downloads an on-device model once (multi-GB, Wi-Fi recommended). After that, compression stays private and works with no signal at all.
OCR, AI, history, and narration all run on this device. No account, no cloud, no data cost. It works in airplane mode.
Offline AI reading assistant. No internet, no data cost, nothing leaves your phone.

The only reading assistant that never sends your pages anywhere - it works with airplane mode on and costs zero data.

snapaie photographs any page, reads it with on-device OCR, then runs Gemma locally to deliver concise meaning, the core idea, author intent, a simplified explanation, actionable takeaways, and CEFR vocabulary.

- 100%% offline AI after a one-time model download
- Works with no internet: no data charges, ever
- Nothing leaves your device: no account, no login, no cloud sync
- Snap selected text from any app, or share pages and PDFs straight in
- Forge Recall: spaced repetition that turns what you read into what you remember
- Follow-up chat, writing tools, and narration - all on-device
- One-time Pro unlock. No subscription.
snapaie Pro is a one-time purchase handled by Google Play. There are no ads and no subscriptions.
